chapter: Chicago, Ohio and Jelly Roll Morton
title: Chicago, Wallace Bishop's house and first recording with Jelly Roll Morton
summary: He lands at drummer Wallace Bishop's house in Chicago, where Jelly Roll Morton finds him and records with Bishop's group around 1926-27.

bands.name: Jelly Roll Morton's Red Hot Peppers

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: But I want to get you back, get you out of Oklahoma...
Out of Minneapolis.
Out of Minneapolis, I mean.
Now, I don't know how I got to Minneapolis, but I got out of there.
Where did you go? Did you go back home or did you go...?
No, I went to Chicago.
Oh, you went to Chicago. You probably followed one of them bands on down there.
Well, I wound up at Wallace Bishop's house. And Eddie told me that it seemed like Wallace Bishop's house was a place that musicians knew to go when they went to
Thomas - 52
Chicago. Because that's where I was staying when Jelly Roll found me. And Jelly Roll had a recording...
Jelly Roll Morton.
Yeah, he had a recording date, and he called Wallace, and Wallace was involved with some little band, see. So he got all of us, see.
Wallace Bishop, the drummer?

Yeah. He took this whole band, and... The guitar player in there, he knew him, too -- he was from Chicago. And that's how I met Jelly. And I did this recording date with him in Chicago... And I don't know how I got involved with it. I can't remember how I got involved with going to these other places. But then I joined him again in...
But you recorded with Jelly.
Yeah, I recorded with Jelly.
What year was that?
That had to be around '26... 1926 or '27.
Because see, Jelly Roll came from California to Chicago and he set up that Red Hot Peppers. Was that part of that?
Yes. And then he did the Red Hot Peppers in New York, too, I think.
Thomas - 53
But did you... Can you remember the singer he had?
No. Although he had some girl singer. There is a guy here, up in Connecticut... There's another one, that he knows...he's got the whole thing.
Oh, he's got all this...
He knows all the guys. He's got all the guys' names. He's from overseas, and he's in...
No. He's a dentist. He's involved in all of that stuff, you know...
Discography.

Yeah, and going... Because he had an interview with me, and he's had an interview with Frazier. He wants to see my brother, because he's got his name. And I was down in Oklahoma, and a guy had seen Victor... A lot of that stuff was on Victor, and they had it in the catalogue, all the guys that were with Jelly.
Was your name on it?
Yeah.
Oh, that's great. I see. So then you left. So Jelly went someplace else, huh?
